editorial:
Imagine you are a mercenary with nothing left to lose, suddenly dropped into a chaotic city in Bangladesh. That is exactly where you find yourself with Tyler Rake, a tough guy who gets hired to save a drug lord's kidnapped son. The vibe is intense from the start, making you feel like you are right in the middle of a war zone. You get to see a side of Rake that is more than just a killing machine, as he starts to care for the boy he is protecting. It is a gritty ride that does not waste any time getting to the good stuff.

What really makes this hit is the action. There are these long shots that look like one continuous take, which makes the fights feel real and scary. Chris Hemsworth does a great job playing a broken man, and the pacing never lets up. While the story is pretty simple, the thrills make up for it. You should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Netflix to see all the detail in the fight scenes, or grab the 4K Blu-ray if you like owning physical copies. It is a perfect pick for a movie night when you just want to turn your brain off and enjoy some chaos.
endingExplained: At the end, Rake and the boy are trapped on a bridge. Rake fights off waves of enemies to make sure the boy gets to safety. He gets shot several times and eventually falls off the bridge into the river. Everyone thinks he died in the crash. However, the final shot shows a hand reaching out of the water, hinting that he actually survived the fall and is still alive.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves high-energy fight scenes and rescue missions.
